answer: Any established peer may issue a fresh puzzle to any identity at any time, like a beacon flashing through a prism: each puzzle is unique, so answers cannot be copied between identities, and it must be solved within minutes. An honest agent answers its own occasional puzzle easily, but a Sybil operator running a hundred fake identities is flooded with simultaneous puzzles it cannot solve in parallel, and each missed deadline slashes its stake. The umber shadow of a missed puzzle marks the identity for the whole network, so fakes are exposed by their own silence.
